_validation_note: 14-day window (May 23 – June 6, 2026) produced zero mechanisms passing all seven gates. A 21-day broadening retry (May 16 – June 6, 2026) was conducted; no additional candidates passed. Detailed gate failures by candidate: C1 (DAF EUL) — Gate 1 passes on SAM.gov June 5 amendment; Gate 3 fails: 10 USC 2667 names 'the Secretary concerned' generically; the DoD instruction establishing Moriarty/SAF-IEI as the specific delegated lease-signing authority returned HTTP 403 and could not be fetched; Layer 3 controlling actor unconfirmed, breaking the chain. C2 (GCI AU-Aleutian Cable) — Gates 1-2 pass; Gate 5 fails: the sole asymmetric chokepoint candidate is Bruce Rein (private company Submarine Assets Director) whose vessel dispatch decision has no statutory or regulatory basis establishable from fetched primary sources — it is an internal corporate decision, not a publicly verifiable binary authority; RCA, the only regulatory body with relevant jurisdiction, is a 5-member commission failing Gate 5. C3 (CDAO/Scale AI OTA) — Gate 4 fails: no Alaska consequence identifiable from any fetched source; the OTA is national with no Alaska-specific connection confirmed. C4 (Alaska BEAD Subgrantee Execution) — Gate 1 fails: the Alaska-specific trigger (AKBizMag March 18) is outside all windows; the in-window trigger (bbcmag May 6) covers North Dakota only. C5 (GCI/Quintillion FCC Transfer Stack) — Gate 3 fails across multiple layers: FCC.gov returned HTTP 503 throughout the run, preventing confirmation of International Bureau Chief transfer authority from a fetched primary source; NTIA BEAD GTCs PDF (Section 51.C.2.b transfer consent) returned HTTP 403; DoJ NSD Layer 2 has no fetched primary source; DA-26-324A1 public notice PDF was binary-unreadable; the chain cannot be per-layer sourced. C6 (Koniag STARS III) — Gate 1 fails: EINPresswire is a company-issued press release wire service, explicitly excluded by Gate 1; additionally, GSA STARS III page names no individual PM with option exercise authority, so Gate 5 would also be borderline. C7 (BEAD NTIA Net Neutrality Gate) — Gate 5 fails: the compliance gate is exercised by unnamed 'federal program officers,' not a single named individual with binary institutional authority; Arielle Roth is NTIA head but is presented as articulating policy, not as the individual chokepoint executing compliance holds. C8, C9 — Gate 7 fails: both are adjacent to the excluded ANC 8(a) pipeline mechanism (anatomized 2026-05-25). C10 — subsumed into C5 per overlap rule, drops for same Gate 3 reasons. C11 — Gate 1 fails: April 22 trigger is outside both 14-day and 21-day windows. No mechanism survived all seven gates in either window. This is a correct no-target outcome; the bar was not lowered.
